verdict.rationale: Brevo's own docs say its ecommerce integration can 'attribute revenue to campaigns', which covers per-campaign conversions. Nothing in the pack documents a campaign or automation report showing opens, clicks or unsubscribes. The 7-day raw transactional event export and the event webhooks are developer building blocks for transactional email, not campaign analytics, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: per-campaign open/click/unsubscribe reporting, per-automation-step metrics, time-series/trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: Track customer behavior and attribute revenue to campaigns.
